<a id="brush_shape_0"></a>
### [`brush_shape_0`](../../../../src/data/brush_shapes.asm#L6) `$1868-$186A`

*data*

Brush shapes. Each brush is a list of (dX, dY) offsets from the centre, signed bytes; $80 ends the list. The table at $0dc0 points to the 8 brushes. Brush 0: 1 point.

- **Entry of:** [`brush_table`](../../tables.md#brush_table)
